ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at distal tips; approximate 9:1 ratio of dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region covering the main body of both lobes. High-intensity, irregular geometric blobs are concentrated at the extreme lateral distal points (tips).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency variations. Left lobe displays approximately 11 distinct triangular peaks; right lobe displays approximately 9 visible peaks before the tip cluster. Peak amplitudes vary relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper edge, sweeping upward from the central submerged area toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the far left and far right tips of the fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single horizontal linear disruption of black pigmentation visible on the left lobe, situated mid-laterally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization and associated encrustation on the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, creating an irregular, textured silhouette.
